rationale: Create one Cardinal Portfolio JV record for the closed 50/50 operating-solar investment. Direct SEC, FERC and sponsor evidence establishes that Clearway Energy, Inc. and Fengate-managed vehicles each acquired 50% on March 30, 2026. The company boundary is the 12 reported western U.S. operating assets totaling approximately 225-227 MW, not the full Cardinal portfolio, the broader Clearway platform or individual projects beneath the JV.

afterImage.description: Cardinal Portfolio JV is a 50/50 operating-solar joint venture between Clearway Energy, Inc. and Fengate-managed vehicles. The ring-fenced portfolio comprises 12 reported projects across California, New Mexico and Colorado totaling approximately 225-227 MW, including utility-scale and distributed-generation facilities placed in service between 2010 and 2017. Clearway and Fengate signed the cash membership-interest purchase agreement on October 3, 2025, received FERC authorization on March 19, 2026 and closed on March 30, 2026. Fengate attributes its interest to Fengate Infrastructure Yield Fund and affiliates, including LiUNA participation. The JV is the western operating subset of the broader Cardinal transaction, not the full 610-613 MW Cardinal portfolio or the broader Clearway platform. No later owner exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
